_readme: Per-pair external cross-check results. This is the human-maintained source of truth for QC's external-verification gate (filled in during D6). The QC question is 'are we complete and correct under OUR stated definition (>=1 Big-5 top-flight league or CL appearance for both clubs)?' — NOT 'does our count match every website?'. Record: status (pending|verified), externalCount (under a comparable definition, else null), sources[], checkedAt, missingButQualifying[] (players external sources show who genuinely meet OUR definition but are absent from our registry -> fix the data before publishing), and a coverageNote explaining count differences that arise purely from different competition/level definitions.

liverpool-and-manchester-united.coverageNote: Known historical crossovers exist beyond our set (e.g. Peter Beardsley 1 Man Utd app; Phil Chisnall 1964; early-1900s players). Many fall outside our Big-5-league+CL definition or predate our data; confirm each against the definition in D6.

arsenal-and-tottenham.coverageNote: Known concern: Pat Jennings (Spurs then Arsenal, 1970s-80s) qualifies under our definition but predates our data coverage — verify and, if genuinely missing, this is a data gap to fix before publishing, not a coverage-note item.
